finding.title: The file descriptor `fd` is not closed after use, leading to a resource leak.
The code does not check if the program has the necessary permissions to open `/dev/ttyS0`. Opening device files can require elevated privileges, and the code does not handle this scenario.

errors: snippet.c:1:29: error: ‘O_RDWR’ undeclared here (not in a function)
snippet.c:2:1: error: expected identifier or ‘(’ before ‘if’

scan_orig.message: Check when opening files - can an attacker redirect it (via symlinks), force the opening of special file type (e.g., device files), move things around to create a race condition, control its ancestors
